name: NeRFLiX
definition: Improves novel view synthesis quality by learning degradation-driven multiview blending via a NeRF-style degradation simulator (NDS) and multiview mixer (IVM) to remove native rendering artifacts.
summary: NeRFLiX is a post-processing method that removes NeRF rendering artifacts by learning degradation-driven multiview blending using a simulator and mixer, rather than optimizing scene parameters.
